Nina (CS): Quick blocker on HelixMed renewal — procurement sent PO but vendor code doesn't match our billing entity, and AP wants Net30 but contract shows Net45. They need the signed agreement today. Any fast path?
Raj (Sales): They pushed back on Net45 citing internal policy. Customer rep Aaron says finance can do Net30 if we accept a short-term amendment.
Aaron (HelixMed): Hi all — yes our AP requires Net30 for new vendors. We can sign an amendment or attach a PO referencing the existing contract if Redwood accepts Net30 for 90 days.
Tara (Finance): We can accept Net30 for 90 days only if revenue recognition team gets the PO with correct vendor code and VAT id. Which vendor code did they give?
Aaron (HelixMed): Provided vendor: HM-OPS-009. Attached PO: https://files.helixmed.example/po_009.pdf
Nina (CS): PO shows vendor HM-OPS-009 but contract is under 'HelixMed International Inc' and our billing entity is 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' Vendor code mismatch triggers internal billing workflow.
Sam (Legal): For payment terms change we need an amendment or explicit signed acknowledgment from their legal/finance. Emailed note from CFO is acceptable as interim but we should record an amendment in contract.
Raj (Sales): Time is tight — can Finance accept invoice once we get PO with the correct vendor code and Aaron's CFO confirms Net30 via reply-all?
Tara (Finance): If CFO reply-all confirms Net30 and includes HM-OPS-009 mapping to HelixMed International Inc and VAT number, finance will process. We still need the amendment afterward but can invoice to meet their timeline.
Nina (CS): Aaron, can your CFO send a short email: "We confirm HM-OPS-009 maps to HelixMed International Inc (VAT: GB123456789) and agree to Net30 for the first invoice dated 2026-04-01." That should unblock.
Aaron (HelixMed): Sending now — CCing CFO.
Aaron (HelixMed): "I confirm HM-OPS-009 maps to HelixMed International Inc (VAT: GB123456789). We agree to Net30 for the invoice dated 2026-04-01." (CFO reply attached).
Tara (Finance): Got the email. I'll accept the PO and trigger billing but note: we will include a memo that a formal amendment is required within 30 days.
DocuSign Bot: New envelope created: env-998877 status=sent
Nina (CS): Sam, please flag legal to prepare a 30-day amendment template we can send after invoice.
Sam (Legal): On it. I'll draft amendment: short clause to change payment terms to Net30 for first invoice and revert/renegotiate thereafter, plus vendor code mapping clause.
Billing Bot: Invoice generated referencing PO HM-OPS-009, term Net30, due 2026-05-01.
Tara (Finance): Invoice queued to AP with reference HM-OPS-009 and CFO confirmation in thread.
Raj (Sales): Nice — risk assessed: org churn + vendor code mismatches add ~1 business day on average. Flagging for renewal playbook: include vendor code capture earlier. :memo:
Nina (CS): Closing loop — renewal executed, invoice out. Follow-up: Sam to send amendment template within 24 hrs, finance to confirm amendment receipt.
Aaron (HelixMed): Thanks everyone for the quick help.
Nina (CS): Marking renewal complete in CRM and adding a note about vendor-code step for next renewal."
